summary.title: Summary
summary.text: I'm agree with your summary. since my intent is not clear, I'm accept this. but I want to add a point that the workflows can be updated. so I think it should be versioned just like code changes.

today.title: What exists today
today.text:
the rnd-tools seems out of scope for the demand I have, I built it for office work, mine is more software development. But I do work with office file on the company. so I want to add rnd-tools but just the office related tools.

agree of using this: software-engineering-orchestrator note more the skills are directly used from https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/tree/main/skills/engineering so I want those skills to be able to updated (by claude to fit in with my workflow)

agree with your wording "playbook and lifecycle". playbooks for each projects and lifecycle is the high-level sequences to develope softwares. each project reference to a software, also the project has the development environment also: dev, staging, prod. add this into the design also.

since rules are project scope, I want to have the skills/hooks should check for existing rules for the project before executing, and require me to confirm. the playbook for each project should has rules and of not has, add a warning to the project data to warn me to add rules.

concepts.title: Two concepts
concepts.text: fully agree with your suggestion but added an optional phase after learn is maintain: maintain the entire playbook after learning phase to: update idea convention, how the path is built, update spec schema, format, update build tools, update verify process, update release checks, etc. all of them need to be versioned also so when I'm unhappy I can rollback.
